description: This is a PHP abstract class defining a REST API endpoint for report management within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to fetch report details and enforces implementation of report retrieval logic. It also defines certain parameters and validation rules related to report handling.

classes.name: ReportAPI
classes.description: An abstract class that manages report-related API endpoints, providing mechanisms to retrieve report header and filter information, validated input parameters, and defining report retrieval logic to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a report's header and filter definitions, checks report accessibility, and returns the data encapsulated in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to return an EndpointAwareReport instance.

methods.name: getReportName
methods.description: Fetches the report name from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' endpoint, primarily validating the report name parameter.

methods.name: getReportNameParamRule
methods.description: Defines the validation rule for the report name parameter, ensuring it is a string.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.
